state_profile.voting_summary: Iowa splits between election day voting (59% in 2024) and pre-election absentee/early voting (41%). Polls close at 9 p.m. Eastern; absentee ballots are processed the day before the election and released first, with election day precincts reporting through the night and results essentially complete by early morning. The absentee vote ran D+4 against R+25 on election day, so Iowa's first numbers look far bluer than its finish.
